name: Vondel
description: The Vondel was a G9 Rigger-class light freighter owned by the smuggler and enslaver Alfris Sotin. During a deal where Sotin betrayed the Spice Runners of Kijimi, Spice Runners Zorii Bliss and Poe Dameron stole the Vondel, and their cell of the gang continued to use the freighter.
